title: Authorized WI-10 environment-bound evidence reuse successor
rawUserRequest: Complete the approved WI-10 environment-bound evidence reuse Work Item after its archived branch collided on archive sequence 917. Redeliver the same bounded behavior from current remote main, preserve predecessor evidence byte-for-byte, and complete the full Work Item lifecycle.

declaredIntent.summary: Redeliver only the WI-10 environment-bound reuse policy on current main after a governed archive-sequence collision.

Implementing WI-08 content-bound or WI-09 diff-bound policies.
Changing the WI-07 evidence-binding schema, generic validator, ai_verify, verification context, cache, scheduler, parallel runner, or required-check execution.
Network/provider integration, sensitive-value collection, automatic retries, or any security, scope, governance, or required-check bypass.

checkpointPolicy.reason: Record checkpoints before implementation and finish.

acceptance: The successor starts at exact current origin/main and a canonical conflict-successor receipt binds source, successor, Issue #856, approval, reason, and immutable predecessor evidence.

The policy exposes deterministic environment snapshot and fingerprint functions that normalize runtime, explicit toolchain metadata, and allowlisted non-sensitive host metadata; fingerprints are canonical SHA-256 values.

The policy builds an environment-bound WI-07 binding and returns fresh/reuse only when runtime, toolchain, environment fingerprint, unexpired binding, security scope, and governance policy match exactly.

Missing, malformed, unknown, stale, expired, scope-mismatched, governance-mismatched, classification-mismatched, or environment-mismatched inputs return unknown or stale with action=rerun; no result authorizes skipping a required check.

Focused tests cover deterministic snapshots/fingerprints, explicit/current environment handling, runtime/toolchain/environment mismatch, unknown/expiry/scope/governance cases, unsafe metadata boundaries, and caller immutability.

The file docs/reference/environment-bound-reuse.md defines the API, allowlisted metadata boundary, decision table, and no-integration handoff; all 16 local checks plus hosted PR checks pass before archive, merge, and ai-close-work-item.
guidelines: Treat environment fingerprints as evidence identity, not authority; retain caller-owned security, scope, governance, and required-check gates.
Fail closed to rerun when any runtime, toolchain, environment, scope, governance, binding, or freshness input is unknown or malformed.
Never collect or serialize tokens, provider credentials, or unrestricted process-environment values.
Preserve predecessor evidence byte-for-byte and use the canonical successor transition receipt.
Use locked repository format and lint tools and record generated projections through their owning commands.

intent.problem: The original WI-10 archive allocated sequence 917 from a divergent base and cannot be merged because current main now owns that sequence. Direct rebase would rewrite immutable evidence.
constraints: The user's 2026-08-16 approval permits all necessary successor Work Items to complete the approved plan.
Preserve predecessor WI-10 archive, summary, outcome, manifest, and held branch evidence byte-for-byte; do not add product scope.
Start from current origin/main, bind the canonical transition to Issue #856, and keep WI-07/WI-08/WI-09 boundaries unchanged.
Unknown, malformed, expired, or mismatched environment metadata must rerun and never bypass required gates.
intent.rationale: A clean, explicitly approved successor makes environment identity comparison reproducible without mutating historical evidence or accepting an archive collision.
